title: vicia eriocarpa
intro: Vicia eriocarpa, commonly known as the wolf's bane pea, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating digestive issues and inflammation, with reported health benefits including relief from fever, diarrhea, and dysentery. The therapeutic actions of Vicia eriocarpa are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help soothe gastrointestinal issues and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
